title: 공유 목록
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Synth-pop. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated eighth-note chords with a light chorus effect. A synth bass follows a rhythmic pattern with a short decay. The drums feature a crisp snare and a steady kick with occasional hi-hat flourishes. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, melodic tenor range with light doubling in the chorus. The arrangement includes subtle synth pads and occasional electronic percussion accents. Key of E Major, 105 BPM.
